messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Kannada)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Kannada) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | Tant' | “so” – intensifier of degree | ಅಷ್ಟು | “so / to such a degree” | OK | | è (1) | copular verb “is” (main clause) | ಇದು | “it is” | OK | | amara | adjective “bitter” | ಕಹಿ | “bitter” | OK | | che | conjunction “that” (resultative) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | poco | adverb “little” (slight degree) | ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ | “little / slightly” | OK | | è (2) | copular verb “is” (comparative clause) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | più | comparative adverb “more” | ಹೆಚ್ಚು | “more” | OK | | morte | noun “death” | ಮರಣವು | “death” | OK | | ma | coordinating conjunction “but” | ಆದರೆ | “but” | OK | | per | preposition “in order to” (purpose) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | trattar | infinitive “to treat / discuss” | ಚರ್ಚಿಸಲು | “to discuss” | OK | | del | contraction “of the” (definite article) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | ben | noun “good” | ಉತ್ತಮವನ್ನು | “the good” | OK | | ch' (1) | relative pronoun “that” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | i' (1) | pronoun “I” (subject) | ನಾನು | “I” | OK | | vi | adverb “there” (locative) | ಅಲ್ಲಿ | “there” | OK | | trovai | verb “found” (past) | ಕಂಡ | “found” | OK | | dirò | verb “I will tell” (future) | ಹೇಳುವೆ | “I will tell” | OK | | de | preposition “of” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | l' | definite article “the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | altre | adjective “other” | ಇತರ | “other” | OK | | cose | noun “things” (plural) | ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು | “things” (object) | OK | | ch' (2) | relative pronoun “that” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | i' (2) | pronoun “I” (subject of relative clause) | ನಾನು | “I” | OK | | v' | clitic pronoun “vi” = “there” | ಅಲ್ಲಿ | “there” | OK | | ho | auxiliary “have” (perfect) | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | scorte | past participle “seen” | ನೋಡಿದ | “seen” | OK |

### Items flagged
**UNNECESSARY (source elements not required in Kannada)** - che (both occurrences) - è (second occurrence) - per - del - ch' (both occurrences) - de - l' - ho
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
